decisions.reason: The IMU module gained its own page in 2024 and fits the modular building-block platform, so keeping it in stock costs little while demand is still emerging.

The industrial AC input module has been featured on its own page and in launch announcements for two years, which signals continued commitment to a low-cost option that serves the industrial automation direction.
The relay module is only mentioned on the website, but it sits close to the established offer and costs little to keep, so the option is still worth more than its carrying cost.
The RGB LED module launched recently, so its value remains uncertain, and as a standard modular component it is cheap to keep on the market.
The wallbox remote access service supports the strategic expansion into charging and energy management, so it is a growth option worth keeping while uncertainty resolves.
